description: Playtest 2026-10-14 (11.137, Chullpa): en salas que no llenan su rectángulo (pasillos, salas en L) la cámara se centra en la caja entera de la sala y deja mucho negro. Debería encuadrar la parte de la sala que tiene piso (las celdas usadas del GridMap dentro de la sala).
notes: 2026-10-15 (-fd): measured every room in chullpa, quenoa, totora, cumbre and templo against the GridMap cells of its floor. Since 11.178/11.179 (rooms centered and sized to the camera) every room fills its box; the original problem (Chullpa corridors and L rooms) no longer exists. Only two rooms have a box larger than their cells, Totora's Gancho (south 4 m) and Balsas (between the rafts), and that empty part is water (the Agua mesh, not GridMap): the hookshot crossing and the rafts. Framing by cells would cut it out, so it was not changed. Proposal: close the card.
title: Cámara de sala: centrar en lo que se ve de la sala, no en su rectángulo
